No option can be put forward yet, because the churn limit could not be assessed in this model.

- The comparison is moderately robust under its current assumptions, but it does not test whether churn remains below **4% per month**. The model produces a churn *change*, not a directly comparable monthly churn-rate reading.
- Results also rest partly on Olumi estimates, including monthly churn and feature-value perception; non‑Pro MRR had no supplied starting value and defaulted to zero.
- The most sensitive structural dependency is the link from Pro price to MRR, but its switch metric is not an overall stability measure.

The useful next reasoning step is to define the churn limit in terms the model can measure.
